pictures.author: A. Sdobnikov
pictures.observed: Cream two-storey Millionnaya frontage, raised end pavilion, framed statue niches/upper windows/relief-panel bands, ten-figure portico with lintel/balcony, bounded stairs and side approach ramp.

pictures.author: Alexweg
pictures.observed: Dark stone Atlas poses, standing legs/feet on plinths, bent elbows and hands at lintel beside shared pier. Original faceted representatives only; anatomy/cloth/face detail not copied.

pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Canal-facing corner pavilion with higher attic tier, lower long gallery, framed tall windows/relief-panel rhythm and low green roof. Road bridge/canal/neighbor buildings remain independent; no copied panel subjects/roof eagles.

currentRoundInspection.scope: New Hermitage exterior: exact irregular main outline, two enclosed courtyards and open northern recess, three independently mapped raised halls/end pavilions, cream two-storey classical facades/upper pavilion tiers, green faceted metal roofs, framed upper windows/pilasters/cornices and neutral relief-panel masses. Entrance portico follows the native slanted southern frontage, with ten original faceted Atlas figures/posed arms and legs supporting the lintel, bounded podium/steps/side ramp, balcony rail and simple timber doors. Replace only the parent and three integrated building parts. Small/Old Hermitage/Theatre, their connecting galleries, independent buildings/roads/canal/water remain native. No furnished collections, copied sculpture/reliefs/lettering or exact ornamental inventory.
